program:
app "Bowling" ball ocean
table point team pick Lane_1|Lane_2, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Lane_1)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Lane_2)
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Lane 1" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Lane_1, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Lane_1, pts = 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Lane 2" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Lane_2, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Lane_2, pts = 2
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
list point
describe:
Bowling, in the ocean colours.

- point: team: one of Lane 1, Lane 2; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.

- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Lane 1, pts set to 2.
- text: "Lane 2".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Lane 2, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Lane 2, pts set to 2.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.

- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.

program:
app "Pharmacy stock" pill ocean
table med name text, batch text?, qty num 0.., expiry date, alert date
setting alert_days num = 45 "Alert days before expiry"
state n text = ""
state q num = 0
state ex date = today
field n "Medicine"
field q "Quantity"
field ex "Expiry date"
button "Add" tap add med name = n, qty = q, expiry = ex, alert = ex - alert_days then set n = ""
remind "A medicine expires soon" at med.alert
let soon = count(med, it.expiry - today <= alert_days)
soon "items expire within" alert_days "days" head color if(soon > 0, warn, good)
each med where expiry - today <= alert_days sort expiry as m
  row card tap edit m
    m.name bold grow
    m.qty "left"
    if(m.expiry < today, "Expired", "Expires soon") color if(m.expiry < today, bad, warn)
    m.expiry - today "days" faint
list med
describe:

Works out:
- soon is how many of the med have its expiry minus today is at most alert days.
Remembers while you use it: n, starting at ""; q, starting at 0; ex, starting at today.
Shows:
- a box to fill in n, labelled "Medicine".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Quantity".
- a box to fill in ex, labelled "Expiry date".
- a button "Add"; a tap adds a med with name set to n, qty set to q, expiry set to ex, alert set to ex minus alert days, then sets n to "".
- text: soon, "items expire within", alert days, "days".
- for each med where expiry minus today is at most alert days sorted by expiry:

    - text: the name of the med.
    - text: the qty of the med, "left".
    - text: "Expired" when the expiry of the med is less than today, otherwise "Expires soon".

program:
app "Budget Buddy" wallet slate
table spend what text, amount money, category pick Food|Bills|Travel|Fun|Health
setting budget money = 80000 "Monthly budget"
state m date = today
state cat text = ""
let spent = sum(spend.amount month of m)
monthnav m
if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
goal spent, budget, "spent"
"Safe to spend" round((budget - spent) / (monthdays(m) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day. Last month:" sum(spend.amount prev month) faint
draw 100, 50
  line 0, 50, 100, 0 stroke edge
  poly stroke accent thick 2
    each days month of m
      pt 100 * monthday(it) / monthdays(m), 50 - 50 * clamp(sum(spend.amount month of m where at <= it) / budget, 0, 1)
each spend month of m by category
  stack tap set cat = if(cat = it.key, "", it.key)
    row
      it.key grow
      sum(it.amount) bold
    draw 100, 3
      rect 0, 0, 100 * sum(it.amount) / spent, 3 fill if(cat = it.key, accent, muted)
form spend
list spend month of m where cat = "" or category = cat by day
describe:
Budget Buddy, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- spend: what: text; amount: money; category: one of Food, Bills, Travel, Fun, Health. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Monthly budget": money, starts at 80000.
Works out:
- spent is the total amount of spend in the month of m.
Remembers while you use it: m, starting at today; cat, starting at "".
Shows:
- arrows that move m back and forward one month.
- text: "Over budget by" when spent is more than budget, otherwise "Left to spend", budget minus spent without its sign.
- spent out of budget with a progress bar, labelled "spent".
- text: "Safe to spend", the result of budget minus spent divided by the result of the number of days in the month of m minus the day of the month of today plus 1 rounded, "a day. Last month:", the total amount of spend last month.
- a drawing made of lines, a line through points.
- for each group of spend entries in the month of m by category:
  - a group; a tap sets cat to "" when cat is its key, otherwise its key:
    - text: its key.
    - text: the total amount of the group.
    - a drawing made of rectangles.
- a form to add a spend.
- a list of spend in the month of m where cat is "" or category is cat by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

fuller_style: two sentences, 20 to 35 words
order: start with the problem or reason

app "Sleep diary Pro" bed ink
table night bed time, asleep time, woke time, rested num 1..5 = 3
"Average sleep, this week" faint
sum(night week, (it.woke - it.asleep)) / count(night week) big
"Rested by weekday (lowest is worst)" head
each ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"] as w
  row
    w grow color if(count(night where weekday(at) = index + 1) > 0 and avg(night.rested where weekday(at) = index + 1) = min(1..7, if(count(night where weekday(at) = it) > 0, avg(night.rested where weekday(at) = it), 5)), bad, ink)
    round(avg(night.rested where weekday(at) = index + 1) * 10) / 10 "of 5"
form night
list night by day
describe:
Sleep diary Pro, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- night: bed: time of day; asleep: time of day; woke: time of day; rested: number, 1 to 5, starts at 3. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: "Average sleep, this week".
- text: the sum of the result of its woke minus its asleep over the night this week divided by how many night entries this week.
- text: "Rested by weekday (lowest is worst)".
- for "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun":
  - text: the value.
  - text: the average rested of night where the weekday number of at is its position plus 1 times 10 rounded divided by 10, "of 5".
- a form to add a night.
- a list of night by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

program:
app "Quran" book mint
table read juz num 1..30, pages num 1..
setting daily num = 4 "Pages a day"
let done = sum(read.pages)
goal done, 604, "pages read", "pages"
grid 10 gap 1
  each 1..30
    box height 22 radius 4 fill if(it <= max(read.juz), accent, soft)
      it tiny align center
"Today" sum(read.pages today) "of" daily "pages" faint
heat last 28 days, sum(read.pages on it), daily
"At this pace you finish in" round((604 - done) * 30 / sum(read.pages last 30 days)) "days" faint
form read
list read by day
describe:
Quran, in the mint colours.

- text: "Today", the total pages of read today, "of", daily, "pages".
- a heat map of the total pages of read on that day for each day in the last 28 days.
- text: "At this pace you finish in", the result of 604 minus done times 30 divided by the total pages of read in the last 30 days rounded, "days".
